data.summary: Caller wants a full redesign of a 3BHK in Kothrud.
data.transcript:
Agent: Good morning, Aangan Studio. This is an AI assistant and the call may be recorded.
User: Hi, I'm Priya. I have a 3BHK in Kothrud, about 1,400 sq ft carpet. We want to redo the whole thing.
Agent: Lovely. When would you like it finished?
User: We'd like to be done by March. We're in no rush. I'm the owner, my husband is happy to go ahead.
